title: Great size for the price
text: Great size for the price. I really appreciate the size of this totally worth it only took off one star because it arrived slightly broken and one small piece of it did fall off after arrival but it wasn't so much and really it looks great! I really think it will do a great addition to my crystal collection, but beware it is on the smaller side it's not that big either but the cut on it is just good enough to show it off well and looks clean.
